requirements.description: User prefers properties near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
User prefers energy class D or better, so all classes from A1 to D are included.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is applied as a minimum surface threshold. The capacity of 45 people is not a floor-area requirement and is not converted into a surface filter. Energy class D or better and proximity to green spaces are not among the reference columns and are not applied.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 600 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Applies the four extracted requirements: surface_area >= 600, a 3.0 km radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using haversine_km on latitude/longitude, energy_class in A1–D, and green >= 74. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinate. No property_type filter was added because none was in the extracted requirements.
